message:
@Everyone

Hello there!

The moderator team of Ascendants appreciates everyone that is and has been participating in this server. To lighten up the mood in the server, we will be hosting a fun game event next saturday. A bit away from RuneScape and really focus on having fun, even outside RuneScape. The event will be a MECCHA CHAMELEON event and will run from <t:1791226800:t> to <t:1791234000:t> (<t:1791226800:R>) next saturday. (Discord put the time in your local time).

We also (a week ago) made an OSRS Ascendants server. The primary goal is to keep the main conversation in Ascendants, and use this new server as a tool to figure out (or help out) how OSRS works together with Ascendants members. If you want to join us, feel free to do so!

Also, respond with the flag of the country you are from (No Maarcus you are not from Iraq)

Kind regards,

Ascendants Moderators
